# Vtrata

> AI-powered budgeting app that turns receipt photos and voice notes into categorized expense records, with no bank account linking.

## Key facts

- Platforms: iOS (live on the App Store), Android (not yet released)
- Pricing: Free ($0, 20 AI scans/month), Basic ($3/mo, 200 scans), Plus ($5/mo, 500 scans), Premium ($10/mo, 2,000 scans + voice expense entry) — full details at /what-is-vtrata
- App interface languages: English, Spanish, Ukrainian
- Core capability: photograph a receipt or speak a purchase out loud; AI extracts the merchant, individual items, and total automatically
- Key differentiator: unlike bank-linking budgeting apps, Vtrata never connects to a bank account — it works with cash, foreign cards, and in any country, and nothing breaks when a user switches banks or resets a password
- Released on the App Store in September 2026
